shortDescription.en: The book introduces the holiday in Italy. Its discussion turns to four women sharing a villa. Another section examines loneliness and friendship. The source also develops marriage and independence. A later passage addresses change through companionship. Together, these subjects frame the book’s fiction focus.

en: The book begins with the holiday in Italy and then sets it beside four women sharing a villa. Its sections give distinct attention to loneliness and friendship, tracing how these ideas or events enter the wider subject. The order places the first two topics before the more detailed discussion that follows.

Later material discusses marriage and independence and change through companionship. These strands establish the book’s scope and help readers decide where to begin. The sequence of topics makes clear which questions or events receive sustained attention in the text.
fr: Le texte commence par the holiday in Italy, puis le rapproche de four women sharing a villa. Ses sections accordent une attention particulière à loneliness and friendship et situent ces idées ou événements dans le sujet général. Cet ordre fait précéder la discussion détaillée par les deux premiers thèmes.

La suite traite de marriage and independence et de change through companionship. Ces fils montrent l’étendue du livre et aident à choisir un point de départ. La progression indique les questions ou événements auxquels le texte accorde une attention soutenue.
de: Das Buch beginnt mit the holiday in Italy und stellt es neben four women sharing a villa. Seine Abschnitte widmen sich besonders loneliness and friendship und ordnen diese Gedanken oder Ereignisse in das größere Thema ein. Die ersten beiden Themen stehen vor der ausführlicheren Erörterung.

Spätere Teile behandeln marriage and independence und change through companionship. Diese Stränge zeigen den Umfang des Buches und helfen bei der Wahl eines Einstiegs. Die Abfolge macht sichtbar, welchen Fragen oder Ereignissen der Text besondere Aufmerksamkeit schenkt.
es: El texto comienza con the holiday in Italy y después lo relaciona con four women sharing a villa. Sus secciones prestan atención especial a loneliness and friendship y sitúan estas ideas o hechos en el tema general. Los dos primeros asuntos preceden el análisis más detallado.

Más adelante se tratan marriage and independence y change through companionship. Estos hilos muestran el alcance del libro y ayudan a elegir por dónde empezar. La progresión indica las preguntas o los hechos que reciben atención sostenida.

Mai târziu apar marriage and independence și change through companionship. Aceste fire arată întinderea cărții și ajută cititorul să aleagă de unde începe. Succesiunea arată întrebările sau întâmplările cărora textul le acordă atenție susținută.

Dalsze fragmenty omawiają marriage and independence i change through companionship. Te wątki pokazują zakres książki i pomagają wybrać punkt wyjścia. Kolejność wskazuje pytania lub wydarzenia, którym tekst poświęca szczególną uwagę.
